operation.summary: A batch of Gmail Postmaster Tools API requests in one, each a whole request frisket cannot see.
Lists the domains that have been registered by the client.
operation.description: Lists the domains that have been registered by the client. The order of domains in the response is unspecified and non-deterministic. Newly created domains will not necessarily be added to the end of this list.

operation.summary: Gets a specific domain registered by the client.
operation.description: Gets a specific domain registered by the client. Returns NOT_FOUND if the domain does not exist.

operation.summary: List traffic statistics for all available days.
operation.description: List traffic statistics for all available days. Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if user does not have permission to access TrafficStats for the domain.

operation.summary: Get traffic statistics for a domain on a specific date.
operation.description: Get traffic statistics for a domain on a specific date. Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if user does not have permission to access TrafficStats for the domain.

operation.summary: Executes a batch of QueryDomainStats requests for multiple domains.
operation.description: Executes a batch of QueryDomainStats requests for multiple domains. Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if you don't have permission to access DomainStats for any of the requested domains.

operation.summary: Retrieves a list of all domains registered by you, along with their corresponding metadata.
operation.description: Retrieves a list of all domains registered by you, along with their corresponding metadata. The order of domains in the response is unspecified and non-deterministic. Newly registered domains will not necessarily be added to the end of this list.

operation.summary: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Adds a domain to the user's account.
operation.description: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Adds a domain to the user's account. Returns INVALID_ARGUMENT if a domain is not provided. Returns ALREADY_EXISTS if the domain is already registered by the user.

operation.summary: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Deletes a domain from the user's account.
operation.description: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Deletes a domain from the user's account. Returns NOT_FOUND if the domain is not registered by the user.

operation.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a domain registered by you.
operation.description: Retrieves detailed information about a domain registered by you. Returns NOT_FOUND if the domain is not registered by you. Domain represents the metadata of a domain that has been registered within the system and linked to a user.

operation.summary: Retrieves the compliance status for a given domain.
operation.description: Retrieves the compliance status for a given domain. Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if you don't have permission to access compliance status for the domain.

operation.summary: Retrieves a list of domain statistics for a given domain and time period.
operation.description: Retrieves a list of domain statistics for a given domain and time period. Returns statistics only for dates where data is available. Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if you don't have permission to access DomainStats for the domain.

operation.summary: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Lists the users that have access to a domain.
[Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Creates a user, who has access to a domain.
operation.description: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Creates a user, who has access to a domain. Returns INVALID_ARGUMENT if a user is not provided.

operation.summary: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Deletes a user from a domain.
operation.description: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Deletes a user from a domain. Returns NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist.

operation.summary: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Retrieves detailed information about a user that has access to a domain.
operation.description: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Retrieves detailed information about a user that has access to a domain. Returns NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist.

operation.summary: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Updates a user for a domain.
operation.description: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Updates a user for a domain. Only Owners and Admins can execute this RPC, only a user's domain permission will be allowed to be updated. Returns NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist. Returns INVALID_ARGUMENT if a permission is not provided or is PERMISSION_UNSPECIFIED, NONE, or OWNER.

operation.summary: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Gets a verification token used for verifying a user's ownership over a domain.
[Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Verifies a user's ownership of a domain at the DNS level.
operation.description: [Developer Preview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview): Verifies a user's ownership of a domain at the DNS level. Note that this is distinct from checking if the user has OWNER status within IRDB.
